# Must the anchor body in Whole Body Tracking be equal to the USD root link or the main IMU link?

> **Current answer:** The original poster indicated that the implementation allows any rigid body to be set as the anchor body, and the deployment process will handle the selected reference body. Therefore, the torso not equal to the pelvis is not a bug. The post does not specify the exact transformation applied, nor does it address the issue of different IMU precision during transfer. The model still needs to verify the coordinate transformation in the code.
